_doc: TNPCB industry_type code -> the sector toggle it joins on a Tamil Nadu district map; one lookup for every new district.
The register (TNGIS generic_viewer:industry_cad_matched) prints each unit's type as
'<code>/<description>'. Sector is read from the CODE, never from a text match on the
name or description: a text match put Britannia among the tanneries.
Codes are not stable across districts, or even within one: 1072 is a TSDF in Krishnagiri
and a steel furnace in Erode, Tiruvallur and Tiruchirappalli; 1081 is a sewage plant
everywhere but one Tiruppur unit, a thermal power plant. So every rule carries
'descriptionHas', a word every observed spelling of that code's meaning contains.
Codes not listed here, or whose description lacks the word, fall to the category's
'treatment' rules leave the industry layer and join the treatment-plants layer.

review.extractedBy: merged from the erode-rivers and krishnagiri-rivers lookups 2026-10-20; guards read from the distinct type strings in the register pulls of 13 districts (Erode, Krishnagiri, Namakkal, Salem, Tiruvallur, Tiruppur, Dindigul, Karur, Vellore, Ranipet, Tirupathur, Thanjavur, Tiruchirappalli; 12,695 units)
